summary: Practise AI inventories, vendor controls, risk assessments, and board reporting. Explore responsible AI governance training with TrainingCred.
lede: Responsible AI governance training helps governance, procurement, technology, audit, and privacy teams turn AI policies into operational controls. Participants practise creating AI inventories and risk assessments, reviewing supplier controls, and defining human oversight and incident workflows. They also develop monitoring and board-reporting records; advanced monitoring and impact-assessment methods are covered operationally or conceptually, rather than through technical implementation.
audienceIntro: This AI governance course is designed for professionals who set, operate, procure, monitor, or independently assure organizational AI controls across public and private institutions.
modules: NIST AI RMF Inventory and Classification
prerequisites: Working familiarity with at least one area such as technology operations, procurement, compliance, audit, legal review, privacy, or risk management is recommended. No coding or model-development experience is required. Bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel or another spreadsheet program. Exercises use workshop scenarios rather than requiring access to organizational AI systems or confidential data.
